topic_ko: 파리지옥풀은 감각모가 건드려진 횟수와 자극 사이의 시간을 세어 진짜 먹이만 가둔다

passage: The Venus flytrap is a carnivorous plant whose paired leaves work as both mouth and stomach.
Tiny hairs stand on the inner face of each leaf, waiting for something to brush against them.
A single touch, however, is not enough to shut the leaf.
Laboratory tests revealed that the plant keeps track of how often those hairs are bumped.
It also measures the gap between one bump and the next, closing only when two arrive inside twenty seconds.
Should that window expire, the plant simply starts its count over from zero.
More than three touches are needed before digestive chemicals are released.
Because of this careful arithmetic, rain and falling leaves never fool the plant into wasting energy.
choices: how a carnivorous plant uses counting to tell real prey from false alarms
why insects are attracted to the bright inner surface of flytrap leaves
the chemical structure of the enzymes that break down animal tissue
how gardeners can grow Venus flytraps successfully at home
the evolutionary reason plants gave up photosynthesis for hunting
theme.explanation_ko: 감각모가 건드려진 횟수와 자극 사이의 시간을 세어 빗방울·낙엽 같은 헛된 자극을 걸러 낸다는 내용이므로 ①이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ② 곤충이 유인되는 이유는 언급이 없다. ③ 효소의 화학 구조는 다루지 않는다. ④ 재배법은 본문 밖의 내용이다. ⑤ 광합성 포기라는 진화적 설명은 나오지 않는다.

passage: Meat-eating plants must decide when something touching them is worth catching.
The Venus flytrap solves this problem with a pair of leaves that serve as jaws and a stomach.
Trigger hairs line the inner surface, and brushing them once does nothing at all.
An experiment showed that the plant registers the number of touches it receives.
It even times them, snapping shut only when two touches fall within a twenty second window.
After twenty seconds have gone by, the counter returns to zero.
Enzymes appear only after the count passes three, confirming that live prey is inside.
This arithmetic keeps the plant from spending its energy on raindrops or fallen leaves.
choices: 육식 식물은 곤충보다 빗물에서 더 많은 양분을 얻는다.
파리지옥풀은 자극의 횟수와 간격을 세어 헛된 소비를 피한다.
식물의 감각모는 동물의 신경 세포와 구조가 동일하다.
파리지옥풀의 잎은 한 번 닫히면 다시 열리지 않는다.
덫 식물은 다른 식물보다 훨씬 빠르게 성장한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 횟수와 시간 간격을 세는 계산 덕분에 헛된 자극에 에너지를 낭비하지 않는다는 것이 요지이므로 ②가 적절하다.
gist.distractor_ko: ① 빗물에서 양분을 얻는다는 말은 없다. ③ 신경 세포와의 구조 비교는 등장하지 않는다. ④ 20초 후 초기화된다는 서술과 어긋난다. ⑤ 성장 속도는 언급되지 않았다.

passage: Among plants that feed on flesh, the Venus flytrap stands out for its patience.
Its two facing leaves close like jaws and then digest what they hold.
Fine hairs on the inner surface report every touch to the plant.
Yet one report is ignored, because a single touch may mean nothing at all.
Researchers found that the trap shuts only after two touches within twenty seconds.
If the second touch comes too late, the whole process resets.
Only when the touches exceed three does the plant start making digestive enzymes.
Thanks to that rule, no raindrop or fallen leaf ever costs the plant a meal's worth of energy.
choices: How Insects Escape from Hungry Leaves
The Fastest Growing Plants on Earth
A Plant That Counts Before It Closes
Enzymes: The Chemistry of Human Digestion
Rainy Days in the Life of a Garden
title.explanation_ko: 닫기 전에 자극을 세어 본다는 것이 글 전체를 관통하므로 ③이 제목으로 가장 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ⑤ 빗방울은 걸러지는 예시일 뿐이다. ① 곤충의 탈출은 다루지 않는다. ② 성장 속도는 무관하다. ④ 인간의 소화 화학은 본문과 관계없다.

passage: The Venus flytrap has two leaves that shut like jaws when prey arrives.
Trigger hairs on the inner surface sense every contact.
A recent experiment showed the plant counts the touches and times the gaps between them.
The trap closes only after two touches occur within twenty seconds.
Once 20 seconds passed, the process was reset.
Digestive enzymes wait until more than three touches confirm the catch.
So a raindrop that lands alone leaves the trap wide open.
The plant never spends its strength on something it cannot eat.
implication.underlined: Once 20 seconds passed, the process was reset.
choices: Digestion was completed within twenty seconds of the trap closing.
If the second touch arrived too late, the earlier touch no longer counted.
Every twenty seconds the plant produced a fresh set of trigger hairs.
The leaf reopened automatically twenty seconds after catching an insect.
The plant needed twenty seconds of rest before it could sense anything.
implication.explanation_ko: '초기화되었다'는 것은 20초가 지나면 앞선 자극이 무효가 되어 다시 처음부터 세었다는 뜻이므로 ②가 적절하다.
implication.distractor_ko: ④ 잎이 자동으로 다시 열린다는 내용이 아니다. ⑤ 휴식 시간이 필요하다는 서술은 없다. ① 소화 완료 시간과는 무관하다. ③ 감각모가 새로 생긴다는 말은 없다.

passage: A meat-eating plant, the Venus flytrap owns a pair of leaves that act as jaws and a stomach at once.
When an insect brushes the trigger hairs on their surface, the leaves swing shut, trapping the insect inside.
A recent experiment showed that the plant knew how many times its trigger hairs were touched.
It could even measure the time between these stimuli.
Only if the plant sensed two separate stimuli inside a 20 second time span did the trap close.
Once 20 seconds passed, the process was reset to zero again.
In addition, more than three stimuli were required for the plant beginning to produce digestive enzymes.
Thanks to this system, the plant wastes no effort on raindrops or fallen leaves.

underlines.text: how many times its trigger hairs were touched
for the plant beginning to produce
underlines.fix: for the plant to begin producing

②

grammar.explanation_ko: 「be required for + 의미상 주어 + to부정사」 구조이므로 for the plant beginning 이 아니라 for the plant to begin (producing) 이 되어야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 선행사가 복수 leaves 이므로 act 가 옳다. ② 앞 절과 주어가 같은 능동 분사구문이라 trapping 이 맞다. ③ 간접의문문 어순(의문사구+주어+동사)에 수동태가 결합한 정상 형태이다. ⑤ 3인칭 단수 주어 the plant 에 맞는 wastes 이다.

If an insect touches the trigger hairs on the surface of these leaves, the leaves close and hold it fast.
Amazingly, a recent experiment showed that the plant knew how many times its trigger hairs were touched.
It could even count the time between these stimuli.
Only if the plant sensed two separate stimuli inside a 20 second time span did the trap close.
Once that span had passed, the process was reset.
In addition, more than three stimuli were required before the plant would ignore the enzymes that digest the trapped insect.
Thanks to this process, the plant does not waste effort on raindrops or fallen leaves.

②

vocab.explanation_ko: 세 번을 넘는 자극이 있어야 소화 효소를 '만들기' 시작한다는 흐름이므로 ignore 는 produce 가 되어야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 곤충을 먹는 식물이므로 육식성이 맞다. ② 식물이 수를 센다는 놀라운 사실을 이끄는 부사로 적절하다. ③ 자극을 '감지했다'는 의미로 자연스럽다. ⑤ 헛된 자극에 힘을 '낭비하지' 않는다는 결론에 부합한다.

passage: A Venus flytrap cannot afford to close its leaves for nothing.
Shutting the trap and making enzymes costs the plant a great deal of energy.
So the plant waits, listening through the trigger hairs on its inner surface.
It shuts only when two touches arrive within twenty seconds of each other, and it makes enzymes only after three.
A raindrop strikes once and is forgotten; a struggling insect keeps striking again and again.
In short, the plant survives by ______________________.
This simple rule separates a meal from a false alarm.
No fallen leaf has ever tricked the trap into digesting it.
choices: closing its leaves at the very first sign of movement
opening its leaves whenever the weather turns rainy
growing new trigger hairs after every failed capture
sharing its enzymes with the insects it fails to catch
treating quick repeated touches as the sign of live prey
blank.explanation_ko: 짧은 간격으로 반복되는 자극만을 살아 있는 먹이의 신호로 받아들인다는 것이 앞뒤 설명의 요약이므로 ⑤가 적절하다.
blank.distractor_ko: ② 비가 오면 잎을 연다는 내용은 없다. ③ 감각모가 새로 자란다는 서술은 없다. ④ 효소를 나눠 준다는 것은 무의미하다. ① 첫 신호에 바로 닫는다는 것은 본문과 정반대이다.

order.given: The Venus flytrap, a meat-eating plant, owns a pair of leaves that work as jaws and a stomach. Fine trigger hairs stand on the inner surface of those leaves, and when an insect brushes them the leaves swing shut.

blocks.A: Because of this rule, the plant ignores a raindrop that strikes only once, or a leaf that falls and lies still. It never wastes energy trying to trap and digest something it cannot eat.
blocks.B: Amazingly, a recent experiment showed that the plant keeps track of how many times those hairs are touched, and even measures the time between the touches.
blocks.C: The trap shut only when two touches came within a twenty second span, and once that span passed the count started over. More than three touches were needed before digestive enzymes were made.

order.explanation_ko: 덫의 구조(주어진 글) → 계수 능력의 발견(B) → 20초·세 번이라는 구체적 규칙(C) → 그 규칙의 결과인 헛된 자극 무시(A) 순이 자연스럽다.
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 규칙 설명은 (B)가 말한 '횟수와 시간'을 구체화한 것이므로 (B) 뒤여야 하고, (A)의 'Because of this rule' 은 규칙이 제시된 (C) 뒤에만 올 수 있다.

insert.distractor_ko: ③ 이전에 넣으면 아직 첫 번째 조건인 20초 규칙이 제시되지 않아 '추가'가 성립하지 않는다. ⑤ 뒤에 넣으면 결론이 먼저 나오고 조건이 뒤따라 논리가 뒤집힌다.

passage: The Venus flytrap eats insects with a pair of leaves that act as jaws and a stomach.
Trigger hairs cover the inner surface and sense every contact.
One contact, though, is never enough to make the leaves move.
An experiment proved that the plant records both the number of touches and their timing.
Two touches inside twenty seconds close the trap.
If the second touch comes later than that, the count is wiped clean.
Enzymes are made only after more than three touches confirm a living catch.
As a result, raindrops and fallen leaves cost the plant nothing.
summary.summary_template: By __(A)__ both how often and how quickly its trigger hairs are touched, the Venus flytrap avoids __(B)__ its energy on things that are not food.
summary.explanation_ko: 자극의 횟수와 속도를 '측정'함으로써 먹이가 아닌 것에 에너지를 '낭비'하는 일을 피하므로 measuring–wasting 이 적절하다.
summary.distractor_ko: ignoring·hiding 은 자극을 세는 행동과 반대이고, storing(저장하다)·saving(아끼다)은 avoid 뒤에 놓이면 의미가 정반대가 된다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그 파리지옥풀은 자신의 감각모가 몇 번 건드려졌는지를 알고 있었다.
writing.answer: The Venus flytrap knew how many times its trigger hairs were touched.
writing.explanation_ko: 간접의문문이므로 「의문사구(how many times) + 주어 + 동사」 어순을 지키고, 감각모는 건드려지는 대상이므로 수동태 were touched 를 쓴다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그 식물이 효소를 만들어 내기 시작하려면 세 번을 넘는 자극이 필요했다.
conditions: to부정사의 의미상 주어를 「for + 명사」로 쓸 것
required 와 begin 을 사용할 것
More than 으로 문장을 시작할 것
writing.answer: More than three stimuli were required for the plant to begin producing the enzymes.
writing.explanation_ko: to부정사의 행위 주체가 문장의 주어와 다를 때 「for + 목적격」으로 의미상 주어를 표시한다.

writing.question: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.context: If the second touch arrives more than twenty seconds after the first, the counting process is simply ___________ and the plant starts again from zero.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문에서 20초가 지나면 과정이 초기화되었다고 했으므로 reset 이 적절하다.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: If an insect touches the trigger hairs on the surface of these leaves, the leaves close, trapping the insect.
writing.answer: 곤충이 이 잎들의 표면에 있는 감각모를 건드리면, 잎이 닫히면서 그 곤충을 가둔다.
writing.explanation_ko: trapping 이하는 앞 절과 주어가 같은 능동 분사구문으로, '~하면서'라는 동시 동작을 나타낸다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.summary: The Venus flytrap can __(A)__ the time between stimuli, so it does not try to digest raindrops or fallen __(B)__.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문에서 식물은 자극 사이의 시간까지 count 할 수 있었고, 헛된 자극의 예로 raindrops or fallen leaves 가 제시된다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 이 글의 주제문을 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
conditions: count 와 energy 를 반드시 포함할 것
writing.answer: The Venus flytrap counts touches and their timing so that it never wastes energy.
writing.explanation_ko: 자극을 세는 능력과 에너지 낭비 방지라는 인과를 한 문장에 담으면 된다.
